# Verification of Compilation State

The verify feature checks against the expected state of the repository to ensure that the incremental compilations do not diverge from what a full compilation would yield. It highlights discrepancies without altering the state of the repository.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
